item.title: What If Anakin Skywalker Found And RELEASED Dagen Gera During The Clone Wars
item.description:
Dagan Gera was a powerful Jedi Knight who lived during the High Republic era, more than 200 years before the Clone Wars. Dagan discovered the mysterious planet Tanalorr, a world hidden deep within the dangerous Koboh Abyss, and dreamed of turning it into a sanctuary for the Jedi Order. However, when the Jedi Council ordered Tanalorr abandoned following an attack by the Nihil, Dagan became consumed by anger, turning against his fellow Jedi before being defeated and stuck in a bacta tank by his close friend, Santari Khri. Dagan remained trapped there for over two centuries...
